text:
Anya: Quick sync — we need a landing copy pass for the Hosted / Dedicated / Private pages before launch next Tue. Final hero, a short benchmark callout, webinar hook, and inbound routing rules. Who can join a 10am quick review?
Matt: I can make 10. I also have the latest latency/cost bench numbers to cite.
Sophia: I’ll draft hero variants and post 3 options for each mode by 9:30. Want tighter CTA language for the webinar sign-up.
Devon: Heads up from legal: avoid ambiguous phrasing like 'private cloud' — use exact product labels: "Private (VPC & on-prem)". Also check KMS mention with security.
MartechBot: Calendar invite sent: https://calendar.example/evt/4970001110. Reminders set 24h + 1h.
Anya: thanks — Sophia please include one short stat per hero (latency or $/token). Matt will confirm numbers.
Sophia: Drafted quick hero options — posting inline for speed:

```
Hosted hero A: "Ship LLM features in minutes — production-grade Hosted API with predictable latency and no infra."
Hosted hero B: "Start fast, scale smarter — Hosted API with transparent performance & usage analytics."
Hosted hero C: "Build with confidence — Hosted text + chat + embeddings, streaming & tool calls out of the box."

Dedicated hero A: "Reserved GPU capacity for consistent throughput — predictable latency for customer-facing apps."
Dedicated hero B: "Dedicated pools, SLA-backed performance — pin model versions and autoscale safely."

Private hero A: "Private deployments (VPC & on-prem) — data control, KMS, and enterprise SLAs."
Private hero B: "Run inference behind your network — full audit logs, HSM/KMS integrations, and on-prem options."
```

Sophia: Suggested one-line benchmark callouts beneath heroes: Hosted: "p50 latency 95ms (chat) — typical front-end workloads"; Dedicated: "sustained 20k tokens/min per pool"; Private: "same runtime, on your network" — feedback?
Matt: For Hosted stat use the 2/24 benchmark: "Avg p50 110ms for chat-16k under 8kb context". For Dedicated, use the redwood-dedicated bench (link) and avoid absolute monthly $ numbers on public page.
Devon: Agree with avoiding pricing specifics. Also inbound routing: webinar signups should be tagged and routed as follows — basic rule: if company_size >= 1000 -> sales, 100-999 -> SDRs, <100 -> marketing-nurture. Also attach 'mode interest' (hosted/dedicated/private).
Anya: Can you paste a sample routing payload so eng can wire it?
Devon: sample payload (JSON):
```
{
  "email": "lead@example.com",
  "company_size": 1200,
  "interest": "Dedicated",
  "utm_campaign": "launch-apr-2026"
}
```
Devon: And rule logic: if interest=="Private" and company_size>=500 -> route to enterprise-sales; else follow normal sizing bucket.
Sophia: CTA copy options for webinar sign-up: "Save my seat — see a live run of Hosted + Dedicated" / "Join the launch demo: performance, cost, & rollout" / "Webinar: production inference patterns" — which lands?
Matt: Lean toward the first two. Also add a small line under CTA: "Includes benchmark walkthrough + live Q&A" — helps conversion.
Anya: OK action list: Sophia finalize hero A/B for each mode + one-line benchmark hints; Matt to confirm canonical bench strings and send links; Devon to provide routing spec + sample webhook fields; Marketing ops to wire forms to tags. 10am review confirmers: @Matt @Sophia @Devon.
Sophia: On it — will post updated copy by 9:30 and a short mock of the hero area (image + text).
Matt: I’ll drop the benchmark doc link in thread after the 8:45 run.
Devon: I'll open a GH issue for the routing mapping and assign eng-platform.
Anya: Love it. If we can lock hero + CTA today we can push to staging copy tonight. :thumbsup:
MartechBot: Webinar registration form created: https://forms.example/launch-apr-2026 — mapped fields: email, company_size, interest, utm.
Sophia: small tweak request — for Private hero, replace 'audit logs' with 'audit trail' to match legal glossary.
Devon: approved.
Anya: Great work team — see you at 10.
Matt: See you.
Sophia: 👍
Devon: ✅
